reason: The Basement Clinic billed them for family therapy they never attended. Mayor Raven holds the eviction AND the invoice. They collect coping evidence — violence as homework — so the clinic does not seize the apartment or the Son's tutoring license.

film1.text: RAVEN WHARF. NIGHT. THE BASEMENT CLINIC STILL HAS THE LIGHTS ON.
They billed us for a session we skipped. That's not a metaphor.
I was networking. In the alley. With my feelings.
MAYOR RAVEN HOLDS THE EVICTION. AND THE INVOICE. SAME CLIPBOARD.

comics.title: PAST DUE
comics.text: FAMILY THERAPY × 12. NOBODY SAT DOWN. THE COUCH STILL CHARGED RENT.

comics.title: THE FATHER
comics.text: I DIDN'T EVEN TAKE OFF MY SHOES.

comics.title: THE SON
comics.text: YOU NEVER DO. THAT'S THE INVOICE.

film2.text: HOMEWORK: COLLECT COPING EVIDENCE. FILE IT IN BLOOD.
If we file this, I keep the tutoring license. You keep the fridge.
That's called a parenting win. Come on.
DOCK STREET IS STILL HIRING. THEY LIE ABOUT THAT.

tutorial_alley.title: TUTORIAL ALLEY
tutorial_alley.main: Learn the three languages: jump, gun, punch. Then lie about growth.
tutorial_alley.side: Hit the dummy like it billed you.

lines.text: Jump. Punch. Don't make it a personality.
I have a personality. It's unemployed.

dock_street.title: DOCK STREET
dock_street.main: Pull the first stack of coping evidence off Dock Street before the clinic posts it on the door.
dock_street.side: Smash a crate. That's a feeling with a lid.

lines.text: If anyone asks, this is homework.
If anyone asks, you're the assignment.
Roofs. Gaps. Try not to make a speech.
I was going to say I believe in us.
Gun stretch. I brought a personality and three bullets.
Two of those are imaginary.

intake_lot.title: THE INTAKE LOT
intake_lot.main: Hold the flooded car park for a coping hour. Elites come in packs. The magnet is the love language.
intake_lot.side: Vacuum eight experience chips. The clinic calls them insights.

lines.text: This is the waiting list. It bites.
I validate the horde. Then I park on it.

fire_escapes.title: THE FIRE ESCAPES
fire_escapes.main: Cross the roofs and file a vertical alibi before the vendor sells your name.
fire_escapes.side: Buy a second opinion. Or steal the silence.

lines.text: Gaps. Glide. If you fall, make it a joke.
My joints already filed a complaint.
Street still bites under the poetry.
That's the brawl section. Try punching it.

group_circle.title: GROUP CIRCLE
group_circle.main: Survive the courtyard share. Nobody passes the talking stick. Everybody brings a chair.
group_circle.side: Let the magnet do the processing.

lines.text: I pass. That's growth.
You pass like a kidney stone.

boss.title: The Facilitator
boss.sub: WE HEAR YOU. WE BILL YOU.

neon_exchange.title: NEON EXCHANGE
neon_exchange.main: Cash the feelings before the agents pawn your pulse.
neon_exchange.side: Pick up a board or a pistol. Sharing is a weapon.

lines.text: Smile. Agents tax that.
I smiled in 2009. I'm still paying interest.
Pawn & Plate. Sell the pipe, keep the wound.
That's the mission statement.

waiting_room.title: THE WAITING ROOM
waiting_room.main: Hold the fluorescent forever-room. Numbers skip you on purpose.
waiting_room.side: Don't sit. Sitting is how they win.

lines.text: We're number 88. There is no 87.
I brought a magazine from 1994. It's still angry.

rail_bridge.title: RAIL BRIDGE
rail_bridge.main: Pay the toll in personality. Keep a grenade as a receipt.
rail_bridge.side: Ride a boxcar roof. The street still bites.

lines.text: Bots don't blink. I respect the work ethic.
You blinked in 2011 and called it a sabbatical.

city_hall.title: CITY HALL
city_hall.main: Climb the statues. The landlord has throwing stars and a mortgage on your name.
city_hall.side: Put the Deputy on the floor. Then the Mayor.

lines.text: Deputy first. Mayor later. That's called pacing.
I don't pace. I loom.
If I lose, we get a nice note on the door.
If you win, we still get the invoice.

invoice_pier.title: INVOICE PIER
invoice_pier.main: Walk the flooded annex. File the original invoice on Dr. Splint's desk. Or his ribs.
invoice_pier.side: Crack a chapel crate. That's the copay.

lines.text: This is not Dock Street with a cold. This is the annex.
I hate water. I hate chapels. I hate being right.
Cranes. I can web that. I can also drown with style.
Parkour first. Therapy never.
Chapel doors. Ushers. Don't tip.
I was going to tithe a punch.
